interfaces.name: lens_bore
interfaces.what: the Ø11.6000 x 7.4980 bore the lens barrel screws into, centred (0.0000, 10.5490, 0.0000), axis +y, residual 0.0000 mm at 355.0 deg — spanning y 6.8000..14.2980, and the frame origin is its inboard end. part:microduck-m12-lens's own barrel measures Ø11.6000 x 7.4000 (a boss, same instrument, same residual), so bore and barrel are the SAME nominal to 0.0000 mm and the barrel is 0.0980 mm shorter than the bore. NEITHER MESH CARRIES A THREAD: both are plain cylinders, so the M12 x 0.5 the name implies is not measurable here and Ø11.6000 is the M12 x 0.5 MINOR diameter, not the major. `accepts` is EMPTY because no threaded-optics connection folder is on this shelf; naming one would dangle. What settles it: a photograph of the barrel, or the lens's part number.

interfaces.name: mount_screws
interfaces.what: 2 x Ø2.0000 x 3.6000 holes at (x, z) = (-10.0000, 0.0000) and (+10.0000, 0.0000), centres y 1.8000, axis +y, 20.0000 mm apart, residual 0.0000 mm at 355.0 deg. Frame origin is their midpoint. They bolt the holder to the face plate; the face plate's own 'camera_mount' is a 13.5000 x 21.0000 rectangle of Ø1.6000 pilots, which is a DIFFERENT pattern, so these two do not mate and what they bolt to is not identified by any mesh in the reference.

interfaces.name: focus_lock
interfaces.what: a single Ø2.0000 x 1.8870 hole at (0.0000, 12.0000, 6.6570), axis +z, residual 0.0000 mm at 355.0 deg — radial to the lens bore and breaking into it, i.e. the grub screw that locks focus. Its axis passes 6.6570 mm above the optical axis, so it meets the Ø11.6000 bore 0.8570 mm above the bore's crown line.
